title: Treasure map
instructions: The X is always 3 cells right and 7 cells up from where you start, but the gaps in the walls move every time. Keep track of where the rover is so you know which way the X is.
hint: Add 1 to x every time you drive a cell to the right, and take 1 away for each cell to the left. To find a gap, drive along the wall and look up after every cell. Once you're through both walls, 3 - x says how far right the X still is.
